crossRefs.note: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they treated them the same way.

translations.web: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they treated them the same way.
translations.bsb: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
translations.kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
translations.asv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them in like manner.
